description: Source code for the ChannelService class in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to manipulate and query channels.

classes.name: ChannelService
classes.description: Provides methods to manipulate and query channels within Mattermost.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by its ID.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by its name within a team.

methods.name: GetDirect
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a direct message channel between two users.

methods.name: GetGroup
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a group message channel.

methods.name: GetByNameForTeamName
methods.description: Retrieves a channel by its name given a team name.

methods.name: ListForTeamForUser
methods.description: Lists channels for a user within a team.

methods.name: ListPublicChannelsForTeam
methods.description: Lists all public channels for a team.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for channels matching a term within a team.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new channel.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing channel.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a channel by ID.

methods.name: GetChannelStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a channel.

methods.name: GetMember
methods.description: Gets a user's membership info for a channel.

methods.name: ListMembers
methods.description: Lists members of a channel.

methods.name: ListMembersByIDs
methods.description: Lists members of a channel by user IDs.

methods.name: ListMembersForUser
methods.description: Lists all channel memberships for a user in a team.

methods.name: AddMember
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel.

methods.name: AddUser
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel as if invited by another user.

methods.name: DeleteMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a channel.

methods.name: UpdateChannelMemberRoles
methods.description: Updates a user's roles in a channel.

methods.name: UpdateChannelMemberNotifications
methods.description: Updates notification settings for a user in a channel.

methods.name: CreateSidebarCategory
methods.description: Creates a new sidebar category for channels.

methods.name: GetSidebarCategories
methods.description: Retrieves sidebar categories.

methods.name: UpdateSidebarCategories
methods.description: Updates sidebar categories.
